  (∀ (i : B), 0 < w i) →
    ∀ (original : (K → E) → ℝ),
      (∀ (c : K → E), 0 ≤ original c) →
        ∀ (opt proxy : K → E) (a α ε δ : ℝ),
          0 < a →
            0 ≤ α →
              0 < ε →
                ε ≤ 1 →
                  0 < δ →
                    (∀ (c : K → E), APC.Preserves (original c) (APC.cost b w c) (ε / 100)) →
                      APC.Approximate (APC.cost b w) a proxy →
                        ∀ (n : ℕ) [inst_6 : NeZero n] (m r : ℕ) [inst_7 : NeZero r],
                          0 < m →
                            3 ≤ ↑m * (ε / 10) →
                              ∀ (solve : APC.Draws B n → K → E),
                                (∀ (sample : APC.Draws B n),
                                    have p :=
                                      APC.sensitivityProbability w (fun i => APC.pointCost proxy (b i)) fun i =>
                                        APC.nearest proxy (b i);
                                    APC.Approximate
                                      (APC.cost (APC.sampledPoints b n sample) (APC.sampledWeights w p n sample)) α
                                      (solve sample)) →
                                  48 * ↑(Fintype.card K) * Real.log (8 * ↑(Fintype.card K) / δ) ≤
                                      ↑n * (ε / 100 / (23 + 22 * a)) ^ 2 →
                                    4 * (64 * a + 8 * a ^ 2) *
                                          (Real.log (8 / δ) + ↑(m * Fintype.card K) * Real.log ↑(Fintype.card B)) ≤
                                        ↑n * (ε / 100 / (23 + 22 * a)) ^ 2 →
                                      have p :=

                                          APC.nearest proxy (b i);
                                      have liftLaw := fun sample =>
                                        APC.liftingTrialsLaw (APC.sampledPoints b n sample)
                                          (APC.sampledWeights w p n sample) (solve sample) m r;
                                      (APC.eventMass (APC.kernelWeight (APC.drawWeight p n) liftLaw) fun sample =>
                                          α * (1 + ε) * original opt <
                                            original
                                              (APC.randomLift (APC.sampledPoints b n sample.1)
                                                (APC.sampledWeights w p n sample.1) (solve sample.1) m r sample.2)) ≤
                                        δ + ↑(Fintype.card K) * (1 / 3) ^ r

  (∀ (i : I), 0 ≤ p i) →
    ∑ i, p i = 1 →
      ∑ i, p i * f i = 0 →
        ∀ (M V r : ℝ),
          0 ≤ M →
            0 < V →
              0 < r →
                (∀ (i : I), |f i| ≤ M) →
                  ∑ i, p i * f i ^ 2 ≤ V →
                    ∀ (m : ℕ),
                      (APC.eventMass (APC.drawWeight p m) fun a => ↑m * r < |APC.drawSum f m a|) ≤
                        2 * Real.exp (-↑m * r ^ 2 / (4 * (V + M * r)))

statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] {B : Ω → Type u_2} [inst_1 : (ω : Ω) → Fintype (B ω)] [∀ (ω : Ω), Nonempty (B ω)]
  {K : Type u_3} {E : Type u_4} [inst_3 : Fintype K] [inst_4 : Nonempty K] [inst_5 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_6 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (ρ : Ω → ℝ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ ρ ω) →
    ∑ ω, ρ ω = 1 →
      ∀ (b : (ω : Ω) → B ω → E) (w : (ω : Ω) → B ω → ℝ),
        (∀ (ω : Ω) (i : B ω), 0 < w ω i) →
          ∀ (original : (K → E) → ℝ),
            (∀ (c : K → E), 0 ≤ original c) →
              ∀ (opt : K → E) (proxy : Ω → K → E) (a α ε δ₁ δ₂ C : ℝ) (p q : ℕ),
                0 < a →
                  0 ≤ α →
                    0 < ε →
                      ε ≤ 1 →
                        0 < δ₂ →
                          δ₂ ≤ 1 →
                            1 ≤ C →
                              (∀ (ω : Ω), APC.Approximate (APC.cost (b ω) (w ω)) a (proxy ω)) →
                                ∀
                                  (solve :
                                    (ω : Ω) →
                                      APC.Draws (B ω)
                                          (APC.randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card (B ω)) a
                                            ε δ₂) →
                                        K → E),
                                  (∀ (ω : Ω)
                                      (sample :
                                        APC.Draws (B ω)
                                          (APC.randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card (B ω)) a
                                            ε δ₂)),
                                      let n :=
                                        APC.randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card (B ω)) a ε
                                          δ₂;
                                      have d :=
                                        APC.sensitivityProbability (w ω) (fun i => APC.pointCost (proxy ω) (b ω i))
                                          fun i => APC.nearest (proxy ω) (b ω i);
                                      APC.Approximate
                                        (APC.cost (APC.sampledPoints (b ω) n sample)
                                          (APC.sampledWeights (w ω) d n sample))
                                        α (solve ω sample)) →
                                    (APC.eventMass ρ fun ω =>
                                          ¬((∀ (c : K → E),
                                                APC.Preserves (original c) (APC.cost (b ω) (w ω) c) (ε / 100)) ∧
                                              ↑(Fintype.card (B ω)) ≤ C * ↑(Fintype.card K) ^ p * (1 / ε) ^ q)) ≤
                                        δ₁ →
                                      (APC.eventMass
                                          (APC.dependentKernelWeight ρ fun ω =>
                                            APC.RandomStrongInput.law (b ω) (w ω) (proxy ω) a ε δ₂ (solve ω))
                                          fun sample =>
                                          α * (1 + ε) * original opt <
                                              original
                                                (APC.RandomStrongInput.output (b sample.fst) (w sample.fst)
                                                  (proxy sample.fst) a ε δ₂ (solve sample.fst) sample.snd) ∨
                                            ¬↑(APC.randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K)
                                                    (Fintype.card (B sample.fst)) a ε δ₂) <
                                                APC.euclideanSizeEnvelope (Fintype.card K) a 32 C p q ε δ₂) ≤
                                        δ₁ + δ₂ + 1 / 3
